cards.text: Nadia reads it straight off the ledger. Fewer losses this fortnight than the one before. More held than lost. She doesn't round anything up.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "That's what it looks like when we bother. Right — next is whoever's still running on luck. I'll draw up a list."
Somebody asks Des if he's happy with it. He takes a second longer than the question needs.
Not quite what he was asked. He lets it go — everyone else is glad, and he isn't sure yet he's right not to be.
